examples/origin_neg_after.sober:8:31: violation the shared cache policy 'Fresh' meets a handler or middleware that reaches a credential source (server.Authorization / server.Cookie / Request.head) in one route — a response that depends on Authorization / Cookie must not be stored by a shared cache — it would be served to other users (language.md 12 節「出所の依存」); use server.Private / server.NoStore for this route, or move the credential read out of it
